curriculumScope: Educational decompositions generated from authored topic data and kind-specific templates; not clinical protocols, not a substitute for supervised training or licensure.
iconScope: Original monoline SVG icon system: every topic has a unique (glyph, accent, ring, dots, flip, badge) descriptor verified at build time. No third-party icon sets are bundled.
languageScope: Traditional Chinese and English authored core; interface strings in 56 languages (lazy-loaded packs, auto-selected from the browser language and region); other languages for content require the configured AI translation route.
billingScope: First section of every course is free; remaining sections require an active pass. Live checkout requires the operator's configured gateway.
aiScope: CPU generative model supported through llama.cpp or Ollama. Verified model weights delivered separately; small models require source checking.
atlasScope: 396-entry directory; interactive bronze figure orders every point along its channel path (teaching schematic, not clinical needling coordinates); qi-flow animation and condition-based point-selection trainer. No needling parameters.
authoredProcedureDepartments: 基礎醫學：解剖、生理、生化、微生物
pharmacyScope: Herbal formula and Western regimen trial-and-error lab: incompatibilities, pregnancy/toxicity rules, formula roles, drug and herb–drug interactions, patient-specific contraindications; no doses.
performanceScope: Fast-start shell (~210 KB) with per-route lazy loading and idle prefetch; service worker caches the shell and public chunks only.
v38Scope: New bilingual topic outlines with explicit guided-template scaffolds; separate fictional editorial reasoning cases. Not independently clinician-validated.
